description: Returns the protocol, network, recipient address, and per-call price for every gated endpoint on this backend. Free to call. Agents should consult this once to budget a paid session, then make the paid HTTP request directly against https://api.seneschal.space (e.g. /v1/q/zec/height or POST /v1/private/watch) with an x402 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header (see https://docs.x402.org).
